input: A camera media record of one clip, its source record, the project media records (through the project database intermediary) and a probe backend bound to that source.
output: The final media record: without a probe when the camera record lacks nothing playback reads; otherwise one probe of each medium that lacks something (claimed in the database first, never repeated), its evidence stored before interpretation and composed with the camera facts, which stay a source. User rule 2026-09-26: if it can go without a probe, no probe; QNC v5 media_probe job.
specification: QNC_v5 qnc-host/src/ingest/store.rs (queue_missing_media_probe_jobs, media_probe_snapshot_ready, record_media_probe_result_conn); docs/23 and docs/26.
